privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.whoText: Only your therapist and the practice {name}. Nothing is passed on to third parties and no third-party services are used; the data is stored in Switzerland.
privacy.whatText: Your entries (done or not, rating, date and time, note) and a log of the accesses. Your IP address is only stored as an encrypted check value to limit repeated failed attempts, and deleted after 30 days.
privacy.whyText: To support your home programme: before the next consultation your therapist sees how you are getting on with the exercises.
privacy.howLongText: The entries are kept with your record. After the confirmation the device stays signed in for 30 days; only a technically necessary cookie is set for this.
